the convergence rate of sign gradient descent is determined by a new notion of smoothness, and that sign gradient descent is faster than standard gradient descent if the objective is strongly smooth with respect to the infinity norm, but slower if the objective is smooth with respect to an intermediate p norm with p between 1 and infinity
